name: Interactions Notification Flow
description: Exercises the two interactions endpoints available through the gateway — escalation and regeneration notification. Both are fire-and-forget (202 accepted). This plot is intentionally thin — interactions is a placeholder for a richer notification and escalation system. When escalate and notify/regeneration gain real processing logic, the response bodies will change and this plot will need to be replaced with one that verifies the downstream effects.
author: seti
